text:
olivia: Quick heads-up  we need to shift the embargo and adjust comms. CEO pulled into an exec meeting and can't do the 11:00 AM livestream. Also compliance asked for an extra line in methodology. Can we triage?
matt: Yikes. What times are we looking at for a new embargo? We scheduled outreach for 10:00 AM PT.
rina: Compliance flagged an ROI comparison callout that needs clarification. We should add one sentence in the methodology and a short note in the press pack. That won't change headline numbers.
jordi: If CEO unavailable, do we want to proceed with blog-only publish + CEO quote in threads? Or delay entire outreach until CEO is on air?
ops_sam: CDN and blog ready. Live stream infra is warmed, but if CEO can't join we can run a recorded clip or have the head of product present. Backup RTMP endpoint ready.
legal_bot: Legal: confirm the methodology amendment text, and any outreach referencing the CEO must avoid forward-looking or guarantee language. Also raw data requests still require NDA.
pressbot: Outreach job queued for 10:00 AM PT to tier-1. I can pause and reschedule if you provide a hold command.
olivia: Proposed plan: Pause outreach. Publish blog at 10:00 AM PT (no outreach), post a short company quote and a pinned methodology amendment, then do a press push at 12:00 PM PT after CEO availability confirmation. If CEO cannot make noon, push to next day. Thoughts?
matt: I like that. Keeps the asset live for reporters who check the site but avoids sending active outreach until we confirm CEO. Social: hold paid promos and delay scheduled paid by +2h until press send.
rina: I'll patch the methodology paragraph: add line "Note: one micro-benchmark used controlled synthetic augmentation; see full methodology for details." Will add a change-log entry.
jordi: For partner comms, I recommend a short private note explaining the change and offering a scheduled briefing. Partners who got pre-embargo material should be notified before the wider press push.
pressbot: Hold placed on outreach at 09:42 PT. Scheduled reminders at 11:40 PT and 11:55 PT.
ops_sam: I'll mark the live stream as "standby" and switch presenters to head of product if CEO unavailable on short notice. RTMP fallback is ready.
olivia: Social plan (draft):
```
10:00 PT - Blog live + pin methodology amendment (no outbound email)
10:05 PT - Short organic post (X, LinkedIn) with link and method note
12:00 PT - If CEO confirmed -> press outreach + paid promos
12:10 PT - If CEO not confirmed -> send partner note + schedule reschedule
```

matt: I'll update the creative to remove CEO-only phrasing and replace with "lead author" language so we can post without CEO. Also will hold paid budgets.
legal_bot: Draft amendment language for public note: "Methodology note: an earlier description omitted that one micro-benchmark uses controlled synthetic augmentation to emulate long-tail inputs. The methodology section has been updated with details." Good to go if Rina confirms placement.
rina: Confirmed. Pinned amendment in /press/methodology_update.txt and changed pack to v2.0. Added change-log entry with timestamp.
jordi: I'll draft partner note and DM partners who received pre-embargo materials. Keep it short and offer a follow-up call.
pressbot: Reminder triggers: 11:40 PT to review CEO availability; 11:55 PT to confirm outreach.
ops_sam: I'll post a 1-line status in #eng-oncall at 11:50 PT and watch stream health.
olivia: OK team. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can own your piece: Rina for methodology, Matt for social creative, Jordi for partners, Ops Sam for infra, Legal Bot for sign-off.
matt: :thumbsup:
rina: :thumbsup:
jordi: :thumbsup:
ops_sam: :thumbsup:
legal_bot: :thumbsup:
pressbot: Outreach remains on hold. Waiting on final "release_approve" token in this thread to resume.
matt: One more note  if we do the blog-only publish, let's add a small in-line note at the top of the blog: "Updated 2026-12-05: methodology clarified; press outreach temporarily delayed." That should reduce confusion.
rina: Done  added the header note and bumped pack to v2.1. CDN purge queued.
pressbot: CDN purge completed at 09:58 PT. Blog header updated.
olivia: Great. I'll lock publish for 10:00 PT. Once CEO confirms (or we have a delegate), post here and pressbot will send outreach. If CEO can't make noon slot, we'll move outreach to tomorrow 10:00 PT.
ops_sam: Live stream marked standby. I'll switch presenters if needed and post status at 11:50 PT.
pressbot: Scheduled check at 11:55 PT for send decision.
matt: I'll keep paid spend paused. If outreach goes at 12:00 PT, I recommend a +30m delayed paid window.
rina: Legal confirmed methodology note placement is visible and unambiguous.
legal_bot: Confirmed. NDA flow link included in press pack. Raw data requests -> legal@noreply.
olivia: Thanks all. If anything changes, update this thread. We'll reconvene at the 11:55 PT check.
pressbot: Thread update: CEO confirmed available at 11:35 PT for 12:00 PT press push. Awaiting final approval token.
matt: Great. CEO will join; social creative updated to include CEO quote block.
jordi: Partners ok with the timeline. I'll queue partner briefing at 12:15 PT after outreach.
olivia: Approve send. release_approve: APPROVE_2105550000. Pressbot, proceed with outreach at 12:00 PT per earlier plan.
pressbot: Outreach resumed at 12:00 PT to tier-1 and partners. Paid promos unpaused at 12:30 PT per schedule. Reminder set for follow-ups at +1h.
ops_sam: Stream live and green. No infra alerts.
matt: Social thread live. Monitoring replies.
rina: Methodology update visible in pack and blog.
legal_bot: All set. Please route any raw data requests to legal.
olivia: Thank you team. Post any press replies here and tag me for escalations.
